pairs.target: tǎ wéi dāying de nà dùnfàn , zuìhòu dìng zài xiūxirì de bàngwǎn .
pairs.english: Tavi’s promised meal was finally set for the evening of a rest day.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维答应的那顿饭，最后定在休息日的傍晚。

pairs.target: mǐlā xiān shuō zìjǐ kěnéng wǎn , gōngfáng de shì tái yào yòngdào wǔhòu . yīwén shuō nà jiù qù jiē tā , pà wò tīngjiàn jiē zhège zì , lìkè wèn yào bān jǐzhī hézi . sū yǐ shuō liǎngzhī , kě zhèhuí bùxǔ shuí yìbǎ quán duān zǒu , xiān děng tā shì wán .
pairs.english: Mira said she might be late, using the works bench into the afternoon. Iven proposed collecting her; hearing that, Pavo immediately asked how many boxes needed carrying. Suyi said two, but this time nobody could carry them both off before she finished testing.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉先说自己可能晚，工房的试台要用到午后。伊文说那就去接她，帕沃听见接这个字，立刻问要搬几只盒子。苏苡说两只，可这回不许谁一把全端走，先等她试完。

pairs.target: tāmen dào shí , shì cáo lǐ yǐjīng liú zhe shuǐ .
pairs.english: When they arrived, water was already flowing in the test trough.
pairs.hanzi: 他们到时，试槽里已经流着水。

pairs.target: liǎngzhī hézi pái zài cáo qián , tí ěr gǎi dào gèzì wàicè , zhōngjiān liúchū zhǎizhǎide dǎo kǒu .
pairs.english: Two boxes stood at the trough’s front, their handles moved to the outer sides, with a narrow guide opening between them.
pairs.hanzi: 两只盒子排在槽前，提耳改到各自外侧，中间留出窄窄的导口。

pairs.target: mǐlā xiān ràng yípiàn kuān yè shùnzhe shuǐ guòqù , yèmiàn zhuǎn le bànquān , guà zài qiányán . tā méiyǒu tuīdiào , děng sū yǐ jìxià shuǐ dào nǎlǐ , cái àn píngcháng qīnglǐ de cìxù , tíqǐ jìn shǒu nà zhī .
pairs.english: Mira sent a broad leaf downstream; its blade turned halfway and caught on the front edge. She did not push it free, waiting for Suyi to record the water level before lifting the nearer box in their usual cleaning sequence.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉先让一片宽叶顺着水过去，叶面转了半圈，挂在前沿。她没有推掉，等苏苡记下水到哪里，才按平常清理的次序，提起近手那只。

pairs.target: yǐqián bèi shù hé shuǐkǒu jiázhù de nàtiáo lù , rújīn zài shì táishàng yòng liǎnggēn mùtiáo biāo zhe . tā de gēbo méiyǒu yuèguò lìngyìzhī hé , hé dǐ de shuǐ cóng yùliú kǒu dīxià , luò jìn sū yǐ bǎihǎo de jiēpán lǐ .
pairs.english: The path once squeezed between tree and intake was marked on the bench with two wooden strips. Her arm did not cross the other box; water dripped from its bottom drain into Suyi’s waiting tray.
pairs.hanzi: 以前被树和水口夹住的那条路，如今在试台上用两根木条标着。她的胳膊没有越过另一只盒，盒底的水从预留口滴下，落进苏苡摆好的接盘里。

pairs.target: shī shā réng zhòng , huànchéng yìzhī , què búyòng bào dào tuǐ qián cáinéng zhànwěn .
pairs.english: The wet sand was still heavy, but one box no longer had to be braced against her legs for her to stand steadily.
pairs.hanzi: 湿沙仍重，换成一只，却不用抱到腿前才能站稳。

pairs.target: ruì shīfu yě lái le . tā zuótiān huí xuégōng jiāo lìng yífèn biǎo , shòu gōngfáng de rén tuō , shùnbiàn kàn chāi qǔ .
pairs.english: Master Rui came too. She had visited the academy yesterday to deliver another sheet; the works staff had asked her to inspect removal while there.
pairs.hanzi: 芮师傅也来了。她昨天回学宫交另一份表，受工房的人托，顺便看拆取。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǒudiǎn yìwài , yǐwéi tā zǒng zài hébiān , zhuǎnniàn yòu xiǎngdào , zìjǐ yě búshì yíxià kè jiù zhī huì xǐ wàzi .
pairs.english: Tavi was a little surprised, imagining she was always riverside, then remembered he himself did more than wash socks after class.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维有点意外，以为她总在河边，转念又想到，自己也不是一下课就只会洗袜子。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu yīnwèi rènshi tāmen jiù xiān shuōhǎo . tā ràng mǐlā bǎshǒu fàngkāi , wèn qǔchū lái de hézi gē nǎlǐ , jiēpán yǐhòu huì buhuì bàn dào tíshuǐ de rén .
pairs.english: She did not approve merely because she knew them. She had Mira let go and asked where the removed box would stand, and whether the catch tray would trip water carriers.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有因为认识他们就先说好。她让米拉把手放开，问取出来的盒子搁哪里，接盘以后会不会绊到提水的人。

pairs.target: mǐlā bǎ zhǐ fān dào bèimiàn , shuō jièyòng yuánxiān fàng tǒng de dìfāng , zhī zài qīnglǐ shí zhàn , píngshí réng guī tíshuǐ de rén .
pairs.english: Mira turned the page over: they would borrow the old bucket space only during cleaning, leaving it to the water carriers otherwise.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉把纸翻到背面，说借用原先放桶的地方，只在清理时占，平时仍归提水的人。

pairs.target: " shuō guò le ma ? " " wǒ diē wèn guò tāmen , shuō kěyǐ shāngliáng . zhège gǎiyàng hái méi gěi tāmen kàn . "
pairs.english: “Have you discussed it?” “My father asked them; they are willing to discuss it. They have not seen this revised model yet.”
pairs.hanzi:
“说过了吗？”
“我爹问过他们，说可以商量。这个改样还没给他们看。”

pairs.target: ruì shīfu diǎntóu , ràng tā bǎ liǎngjiànshì fēnkāi xiě , shì táishàng néng zuò , bù děngyú rénjiā yǐjīng dāying zhào zuò . mǐlā nábǐ bǔ le yíjù , suíhòu zìjǐ shuō , bú dàihuíqù gěi rén shì tí yícì , tú shàng xiě duōcháng dōu búsuàn .
pairs.english: Master Rui nodded and had her record the two things separately: working on a bench did not mean the users had agreed. Mira added a sentence, then said herself that without taking it back for someone to try lifting, no length of writing on the drawing would count.
pairs.hanzi: 芮师傅点头，让她把两件事分开写，试台上能做，不等于人家已经答应照做。米拉拿笔补了一句，随后自己说，不带回去给人试提一次，图上写多长都不算。

pairs.target: shuǐ zài kāi dà , lìng yípiàn yèbǐng héng zài dǎo kǒu , liúliàng màn le xiē , què méiyǒu bǎ quánbù shuǐ bījìn yìzhī hé .
pairs.english: With a higher flow, another leaf stalk lodged across the guide opening, slowing the flow but not forcing all the water into one box.
pairs.hanzi: 水再开大，另一片叶柄横在导口，流量慢了些，却没有把全部水逼进一只盒。

pairs.target: sū yǐ zhào jìlù de shùnxù qǔ xià xiǎo dǎng piàn , yèzi gēnzhe huájìn kě qīnglǐ de gélǐ . tā jiāng nà piàn yè liú zhe , méi ràng rén suíshǒu rēng .
pairs.english: Suyi followed the recorded sequence to remove the small baffle, and the leaf slid into a cleanable compartment. She kept that leaf, not letting anyone casually throw it away.
pairs.hanzi: 苏苡照记录的顺序取下小挡片，叶子跟着滑进可清理的格里。她将那片叶留着，没让人随手扔。

pairs.target: sānhuí shì wán , zuì huài de yìhuí réng yǒu xìshā jī zài biānjiǎo .
pairs.english: After three trials, the worst still left fine sand in the corners.
pairs.hanzi: 三回试完，最坏的一回仍有细沙积在边角。

pairs.target: gōngfáng shīfu shuō kěyǐ zuò yífù nàiyòng de shìyàng , dài qù ràng shíjì yòng de rén kàn , zài yǒurén kānshǒu de shíhòu shì , néng suíshí chāidiào , bùnéng xiān dīngjìn jiù shuǐkǒu .
pairs.english: The works master approved a durable trial model to show actual users, tested under supervision, removable at any time, never nailed into the old intake beforehand.
pairs.hanzi: 工房师傅说可以做一副耐用的试样，带去让实际用的人看，在有人看守的时候试，能随时拆掉，不能先钉进旧水口。

pairs.target: liào qián àn zhècì shuōhǎo de chū , wǎnghòu yào jǐfù , dé děng jiéguǒ .
pairs.english: Materials would be paid as agreed this time; any further sets depended on the results.
pairs.hanzi: 料钱按这次说好的出，往后要几副，得等结果。

pairs.target: mǐlā zhàn zài nàlǐ , hǎo yíhuìer méi shuōhuà . pà wò yǐwéi tā méi tīng qīng , yòu tì shīfu shuō le yíbiàn , tā hūrán shēn jiǎotī le tī tā de dèng tuǐ , jiào tā bié qiǎng zìjǐ dehuà .
pairs.english: Mira stood silent for a while. Pavo thought she had not heard and repeated the master’s words; she suddenly nudged his stool leg with her foot and told him not to steal her turn to speak.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉站在那里，好一会儿没说话。帕沃以为她没听清，又替师傅说了一遍，她忽然伸脚踢了踢他的凳腿，叫他别抢自己的话。

pairs.target: tā zhuǎnxiàng sū yǐ , xiān wèn nǎ tiān yǒukōng . sū yǐ shuō dé kàn zhírì , suíhòu liǎnggè rén yìqǐ fān běnzi , lián xiào yě gùbúshàng .
pairs.english: She turned to Suyi and asked when she was free. Suyi said it depended on duty, then both searched their notebooks, too busy even to smile.
pairs.hanzi: 她转向苏苡，先问哪天有空。苏苡说得看值日，随后两个人一起翻本子，连笑也顾不上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tì tāmen shōu shī mù jiá , kànjiàn mǐlā zhǐ cè nà diǎn méi cājìng de mò , hūrán xiǎngqǐ yīwén qiántiān shēnguòlái de shǒu .
pairs.english: Tavi collected the wet wooden clamps for them; the ink still on Mira’s finger reminded him of Iven’s hand two days earlier.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维替她们收湿木夹，看见米拉指侧那点没擦净的墨，忽然想起伊文前天伸过来的手。

pairs.target: dào chūménshí , yǐjīng bǐ yuē hǎo de wǎn le yízhèn . mǐlā shuō zìjǐ qǐng yífèn bǐng , suàn péi děng rén de dùzǐ . tǎ wéi shuō fàn shì zìjǐ dāying de , tā táitóu shuō zhīdào , suǒyǐ méi qiǎng tā de tāng .
pairs.english: Leaving, they were later than planned. Mira offered bread to compensate their waiting stomachs. Tavi said he had promised the meal; she said she knew, which was why she had not claimed his soup.
pairs.hanzi: 到出门时，已经比约好的晚了一阵。米拉说自己请一份饼，算赔等人的肚子。塔维说饭是自己答应的，她抬头说知道，所以没抢他的汤。

pairs.target: tāmen qù le xī jiē yìjiā mài rètāng de xiǎo pù . qīgè rén jǐ liǎngzhāng zhuō , lí qí zuìhòu dào , jiāng tú tǒng fàngdào qiángbiān , shuō zìjǐ jīntiān méiyǒu liáng , shuí yě bùxǔ ná zhuōtuǐ kǎo tā .
pairs.english: They went to a little hot-soup shop at the West Steps. Seven people squeezed around two tables. Liqi arrived last, put her drawing tube by the wall and said she had not measured today, so nobody could test her on table legs.
pairs.hanzi: 他们去了西阶一家卖热汤的小铺。七个人挤两张桌，黎齐最后到，将图筒放到墙边，说自己今天没有量，谁也不许拿桌腿考她。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yào le yì guōtāng , qīzhī wǎn . bǐng shì mǐlā mǎi de , sū yǐ dàilái yìxiǎobāo yāncài , pà wò bùzhī cóng nǎlǐ tāochū liǎngkē lìzǐ , dé mǎ dīng zhe tā kàn , tā gǎnjǐn shuō zhècì zhēnshì zìjǐ de .
pairs.english: Tavi ordered a pot of soup and seven bowls. Mira bought bread, Suyi brought pickles, and Pavo produced two chestnuts from somewhere. Dema stared, and he hastily said these really were his own.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维要了一锅汤，七只碗。饼是米拉买的，苏苡带来一小包腌菜，帕沃不知从哪里掏出两颗栗子，德玛盯着他看，他赶紧说这次真是自己的。

pairs.target: yīwén bǎ zuìdà de yìzhī wǎn tuī dào tǎ wéi miànqián , shuō qǐngkè de rén xiān shèng . tǎ wéi gěi zìjǐ shèng wán , guō lǐ xiàng hái méi dòng guò , hūrán yǒudiǎn fàngxīn , jiēzhe gěi pángbiān de rén yǎo .
pairs.english: Iven pushed the largest bowl toward Tavi, saying the host should serve himself first. After his serving the pot seemed barely touched; reassured, Tavi began ladling for the others.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文把最大的一只碗推到塔维面前，说请客的人先盛。塔维给自己盛完，锅里像还没动过，忽然有点放心，接着给旁边的人舀。

pairs.target: dé mǎ jiǎng cèzhàn yǒu gèrén néng bì zhuóyǎn fēnchū liǎngzhǒng xiédǐ , lí qí shuō tā zhǐshì bùxiǎng zhēng yǎnkàn tāmen cǎi jìnwū de ní .
pairs.english: Dema told of a station worker who could distinguish two sole types with his eyes shut; Liqi said he just did not want to open them to see the mud they tracked indoors.
pairs.hanzi: 德玛讲测站有个人能闭着眼分出两种鞋底，黎齐说他只是不想睁眼看她们踩进屋的泥。

pairs.target: mǐlā jiǎng gōngfáng jīntiān nà piàn yè , sū yǐ lìjí shēnshǒu lán tā , shuō bùxǔ zài tāng biān zhǎnkāi . pà wò jiào bù láng zuòzài kōng dié páng , gāng bǎihǎo , diànlǐ yǎng de shòu māo biàn guòlái , jiāng tā yì zhǎng tuīfān .
pairs.english: Mira described the day’s leaf; Suyi stopped her at once, forbidding her to unfold it beside the soup. Pavo sat the cloth wolf by an empty plate, but the shop’s thin cat promptly came and knocked it over with a paw.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉讲工房今天那片叶，苏苡立即伸手拦她，说不许在汤边展开。帕沃叫布狼坐在空碟旁，刚摆好，店里养的瘦猫便过来，将它一掌推翻。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào dé tāng xiǎnxiē sǎ chūqù .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed so hard he nearly spilled his soup.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑得汤险些洒出去。

pairs.target: chī dào yíbàn , yīwén wèn tā yǐhòu hái xiǎng buxiǎng qù hé shàng . tā diǎntóu , shuō xiǎng , yě xiǎng yǒu yìtiān dào yú wān qù kànkàn . bù zhǐshì qù wèn nànián de chē , xiǎng zhīdào nàlǐ xiànzài zhù zhe shénme rén , dōngtiān zěnme chīfàn .
pairs.english: Halfway through, Iven asked if he wanted to travel the river again. He nodded: yes, and someday Elmbay too, not only to ask about the old wagons, but to know who lived there now and what they ate in winter.
pairs.hanzi: 吃到一半，伊文问他以后还想不想去河上。他点头，说想，也想有一天到榆湾去看看。不只是去问那年的车，想知道那里现在住着什么人，冬天怎么吃饭。

pairs.target: " xiān bǎ zhè wǎn chī wán . " mǐlā shuō . tā shuōwán , yòu wèn xiàhuí ruòzhēn qù le , kěbukěyǐ tì zìjǐ kànyikàn hébiān de rén zěnyàng tí shī hé .
pairs.english: “Finish this bowl first,” Mira said, then asked if he really went next time, could he also find out how river people lifted wet boxes.
pairs.hanzi:
“先把这碗吃完。”米拉说。
她说完，又问下回若真去了，可不可以替自己看一看河边的人怎样提湿盒。

pairs.target: yīwén shuō hái dé jì dēng , dé mǎ shuō yě biéwàngle dài yìshuāng zhēn néng liànggān de wàzi .
pairs.english: Iven added he must record the lights; Dema said not to forget socks that would actually dry.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文说还得记灯，德玛说也别忘了带一双真能晾干的袜子。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànzhe tāmen , juéde zìjǐ nà běn báo běnzi , dàgài dé zài tiān jǐyè . tāngguō zài zhuōzi zhōngjiān mào rèqì , ménwài yǒurén tídēng xià jiē , dēngguāng zǒu dé hěn màn , cóng chuāngqián jīngguò , yòu wǎng gèng dī de dìfāng qù le .
pairs.english: Looking at them, Tavi thought his thin notebook would probably need more pages. The soup steamed in the table’s middle. Outside someone carried a lamp down the steps, its light moving slowly past the window and on toward lower ground.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着他们，觉得自己那本薄本子，大概得再添几页。汤锅在桌子中间冒热气，门外有人提灯下阶，灯光走得很慢，从窗前经过，又往更低的地方去了。
